summary: Auto-configures an Image for radial fill and exposes a simple SetProgress.
overview: Drop it on a UI Image and it sets up the Image Type and Fill Method for radial fill, exposing a 0-1 API — so you do not have to remember the setup steps every time.
useCases: A circular loading or charge indicator.

params.tuning: Zero snaps instantly, which is what a cooldown usually wants. Easing suits a charge-up.
Top is conventional for cooldowns. Getting it wrong makes the ring fill from a strange place.

gotchas.title: It reconfigures the Image it is on
gotchas.body: The sprite must have a shape suitable for radial fill. A rectangular sprite fills as a rotating wedge, which looks wrong.
